jobs.description: Create Vite+React+TypeScript project scaffold, type definitions, and constants
Implement board operations, win detection, forbidden move rules, AI evaluation function, and Alpha-Beta minimax search
Wrap AI engine in a Web Worker for non-blocking computation with timeout and crash recovery
Create React Context + useReducer for game state management with all actions (PLACE_STONE, AI_MOVE, UNDO, RESIGN, RESTART, SET_DIFFICULTY, SET_PROCESSING)
Implement useAI hook for Web Worker lifecycle management: spawn, message passing, cancel, crash retry, and timeout handling
Implement Board and Stone components with click handling, last-move marker, forbidden move marker, and win highlight
Implement GameInfo panel, Controls (Undo/Resign/Restart), and DifficultySelector with correct disable/enable states
Implement GameOverDialog for win/loss/draw outcomes with Play Again action
Assemble App root component composing board, controls, info panel, difficulty selector, and game-over dialog; wire to game state and AI hook; add responsive layout and entry point

shared_contracts: Player type: 1 (black / human) | 2 (white / AI). CellState: 0 (empty) | 1 | 2. Board: CellState[15][15].
Position: { row: number, col: number } with row,col in [0, 14].

GameState: { board, history: { board, lastMove }[], currentPlayer: 1|2, phase: GamePhase, winner: 0|1|2, winPositions: Position[], isProcessing: boolean, forbiddenMove: Position | null, moveCount: number, difficulty: Difficulty }.
GameAction union: PLACE_STONE(pos), FORBIDDEN_MOVE(pos), AI_MOVE(pos), UNDO, RESIGN, RESTART, SET_DIFFICULTY(difficulty), SET_PHASE(phase), SET_PROCESSING(isProcessing).
Worker request: { type: 'compute', board: Board, difficulty: Difficulty, player: 1|2 } | { type: 'cancel' }.
Worker response: { type: 'result', position: Position, score: number, depth: number } | { type: 'thinking', status: 'start' | 'searching' | 'done' }.
ForbiddenMoveType: 'san-san' | 'si-si' | 'overline' | null. Only enforced for black (player).
Difficulty config: Easy depth=1 attackWeight=0.3 defenseWeight=0.7 timeout=100ms; Medium depth=2-3 equal weights timeout=500ms; Hard depth=4-5 attackWeight=0.6 defenseWeight=0.4 timeout=3000ms.
Win detection: 4 directions (horizontal, vertical, diagonal-left, diagonal-right); >=5 consecutive same-color stones wins; returns winning positions array for highlight.
Context API: GameProvider wraps children, provides { state, dispatch } via useContext. useGame() hook returns { state, dispatch }.
